origin: A 2020 poser gang that copied an alien sitcom and then committed crimes in the costume. Reckoners later did cult without the laugh track. The Morks are a footnote with a rainbow.
text: Use as 2020 weird. Do not use as 2045 comic relief next to Reckoners; the void cult will eat the joke.
hooks: A Mork suit in a University basement is lined with real alien-hunter chrome from a corp skunkworks. No one knows which corp.
A Reckoner stole the bit's 'nanu' as a hymn. The last Mork is furious and armed.
A BD of the old crimes is being recut as comedy. The victims' kids are not laughing.

name: Bay Area Rapid Terror
turf: Transit lines, the joke that was a bombing campaign
look: Transit colors, timers, a name that was a threat
leader: A cell that liked trains too much
origin: A 2020 terror/prank name aimed at the transit map. They made the news. They made the morgues. NCART still has posters that are not about fares. Julliard plays the stations anyway.
text: Historical terrorists. Do not play them cute. A 2045 copycat would shut a city.
hooks: An old B.A.R.T. timer was found in an NCART locker. It is still counting.
A media wants the old name for a thinkpiece. The survivors do not.
Culper Ring thinks a new cell is using the old playbook to frame NorCal.

name: Black Death
turf: Plague-bit corners, chem-warfare posers who got too real
look: Beak masks, black cloth, actual toxins
leader: A doctor who was not licensed
origin: A 2020 cult/poser gang that played plague doctor and then started using real agents. Biotechnica lawsuits and NCPD body bags closed the file. Inquisitors hated the chrome. Everyone else hated the cough.
text: A historical bio-terror crew. Handle like a hazmat scene, not a costume party.
hooks: A beak mask in a Night Market still smells like a lab.
A 2045 cough in the Zone matches a 2020 strain. Biotechnica will pay. They will also erase.
Shroomers found a sealed drum in a side tunnel. The mark is a beak.

name: Blood & Tears
turf: Melodrama clubs, knife poetry
look: Goth before the Vampyres owned it, blades, too much eyeliner for the body count
origin: A 2020 goth combat gang that lost the aesthetic war to the Philharmonic Vampyres and the body-count war to everyone with better guns. The name still looks good on a knife.
text: Historical goth boosters. The Master of the Vampyres will claim they were never competition. The graves disagree.
hooks: A Blood & Tears manifesto is being reprinted as Vampyre fanfic. Acme wants a prank. The Master wants a lawyer.
A knife with the old name was used in a 2045 killing. Copycat or cousin.
A University reading is a recruiting session. The professor does not know.

name: Citizens for Decency
status: Defunct as a gang; the sermon went into Inquisitors and 6th Street pamphlets
turf: Picket lines, club doors, the moral panic circuit
look: Clean clothes, ugly ideas, clubs behind the signs
leader: A spokesperson with a hidden holster
origin: A 2020 'concerned citizen' gang: they picketed sex work, chrome, and joy, then broke bones after the cameras left. Inquisitors did the theology. 6th Street did the block watch. Decency did the press release.
text: Historical culture-war muscle. The Mox and Street Queens are the long reply.
hooks: A 2020 membership list is about to leak. Half the names are 2045 landlords.
A picket line formed outside Lizzie's in a 2077 table. The Mox do not do pickets.
An old spokesman is running for a Night City office. The list is the campaign.

name: Corporate Raiders
status: Defunct as a street name; the job became 'edgerunner'
turf: Office parks, the idea of a hostile takeover with guns
look: Suits and rifles, a merger as a firefight
origin: A 2020 gang that treated corp war as a small-business model. Some grew into real solos. Some died in the Fourth Corporate War they thought they were practicing for. The Afterlife drinks are the sequel.
text: Historical proto-edgerunners with a gang structure. Use as a 2020 crew or a 2045 cautionary tale about branding your war.
hooks: A Raiders letterhead is on a 2045 contract. The client thinks it is funny. The surviving partner does not.
A tower they hit in 2020 still has a backdoor. Night Corp found it. They want it used once.
Rogue will not talk about them. That is the hook.

name: Edison's
turf: Grid houses, light as a racket
look: Lineman gear, stolen IEC jackets, sparks
origin: A 2020 gang that stole power, sold light, and broke the grid for fun and profit. IEC outlived them. The brownouts still feel like a calling card.
text: Historical utility thieves. If the lights die in a district, an old Edison might be bragging in a bar.
hooks: IEC wants a 2020 tap mapped. It is still bleeding power into a Combat Zone chapel.
A brownout matches an Edison pattern. The foreman is 80 and bored.
A kid gang is using the name. IEC will not distinguish.

name: Givers of Pain
turf: Torture houses of the old Zone
look: No fashion, only tools
origin: A 2020 sadist crew listed because Night City lists everything that repeats. Bozos later industrialised the bit with greasepaint. The Givers did it without a theme. They are gone. The tools are not.
text: Do not play them for comedy. A 2045 table finds a basement. A 2020 table can still knock on the door.
hooks: A basement in the Zone has a Givers drain. Something is using it again.
A Bozo circus claims the old tools. A survivor wants them melted.
A corpo 'enhanced interrogation' consultant has a Givers tattoo they think is hidden.

name: Gold Eagles
turf: Patriotic poser blocks, the flag as a jacket
look: Gold eagles, surplus, a patriotism that was a brand
origin: A 2020 patriotic poser gang. 6th Street later did veterans without the parade gold. The Eagles did the parade without the war. The Unification War made the bit look small.
text: A historical flag crew. X Wright will not like the comparison. Use it anyway if you want a fight in a briefing room.
hooks: An Eagle banner at a 6th Street memorial. Veterans take it personally.
A gold eagle pin is a 2020 tracker for a corp loyalty program. It still pings.
NUSA propaganda recycled their look. The last Eagle wants a lawyer in Night City, which is to say a gun.

name: GoldenKids
turf: Rich-kid packs, malls that still existed
look: Money, cruelty, chrome their parents paid for
leader: A trust fund with a crew
origin: A 2020 rich-kid gang: boredom, boosters, and the certainty that Trauma Team would land for them. Some grew into corpos. Some grew into Maelstrom's favorite kind of hostage. The malls died first.
text: Historical spoiled boosters. A 2045 table meets their children in Charter Hill and does not get told the old name.
hooks: A GoldenKid yearbook is a blackmail bible. Half the Night City exchange is in it.
A child of the crew is slumming in Kabuki. The Claws have not decided if they are a client or a lesson.
Trauma Team still has an unpaid 2020 invoice that is also a hit list.

name: Hong Kong Musketeers
status: Defunct as a name; the wire-fu went into Gold Dragons
turf: Little China of the old map
look: Musketeer hats on jump boosters, blades, cinema
origin: A 2020 poser combat gang that mixed Hong Kong action discs with Dumas. Eddy Sing's Gold Dragons are the competent sequel. The Musketeers are the fan film.
text: Historical Little China color. Use a 2020 duel or a 2045 costume in a parlor.
hooks: Ling Po has a Musketeer saber on the wall. Someone wants it back. It is also a key.
A three-person crew is using the old ranks. The Dragons find it cute. Then they do not.
A disc in a Night Market teaches a kata that opens a 2020 cache.

name: Icebrothers
turf: Cold-storage crime, body banks, the pun as a business
look: White chrome, freezer burns, brotherhood tattoos
leader: A pair of siblings, if the file can be believed
origin: A 2020 crew that ran ice: the drug, the NET, the morgue. The name was a joke that stored bodies. Tombstone Preservers later professionalised the respectable end. Scavs took the rest.
text: Historical cold-storage gang. A 2045 freezer with their mark is a dungeon.
hooks: A brother is still on ice in a body bank. The other brother is a 2045 ripper.
Rieper wants an Icebrothers locker opened without a scandal. The locker is a person.
A smash dealer is using the old name. The smash is cut with freezer fluid.

name: Jack the Rippers
turf: Ripperdoc crime, alleys, the name as a dare
look: Surgical chrome, a grin, a newspaper cutting
origin: A 2020 copycat gang that turned a 19th-century murderer into a brand. NCPD used them as a headline. Working people used them as a reason to walk in pairs. Ripperdocs hate the name for obvious reasons.
text: Historical slashers. Do not revive as a joke. A 2045 copycat is a campaign villain.
hooks: A new Jack is using 2020 letters. The Mox (or Street Queens) want them found before the press.
A ripper is being framed with the old mark. They will pay.
A newspaper cutting in a 2020 time capsule names a corpo family. The family still exists.

name: KoneHedds
turf: Full-borg clowns of a different joke than the Bozos
look: Cone heads, chrome skulls, a 20th-century sketch as a war crime
origin: A 2020 poser gang that took a comedy sketch and welded it to booster chrome. Bozos did clowns better and meaner. The KoneHedds are what happens when the bit is a head shape and the ammo is real.
text: A 2020 freakshow file. Use next to Bozos to show that Night City had options and chose worse.
hooks: A cone-skulled corpse in the Zone is a 2020 ganger who just thawed. They think it is still 2020.
A Bozo circus is wearing cones as an insult. A surviving KoneHedd has a rifle.
A ripper is being asked to sculpt a cone. They would like a bodyguard for the consult.

name: Satin Dolls
status: Defunct as a gang; the door work went elsewhere
turf: Cabaret blocks of the old city
look: Satin, razors, a smile that is a cover charge
leader: A doll who ran the books
origin: A 2020 club gang: companionship, protection, and a dress code that hid a blade. Street Queens and the Mox are the longer story. The Dolls are a 2020 room with a velvet rope and a shotgun.
text: Historical cabaret muscle. A 2045 table finds a ledger. A 2020 table can still order a drink.
hooks: A Satin Dolls ledger lists corpos who still hold office.
A velvet rope in Kabuki is using the old knot. Claws think it is theirs. It is not.
A song in the Forlorn Hope is a Dolls calling card. Marianne wants to know who requested it.

name: Second Comming
aka: Second Coming (the street corrected the spelling; the 2020 file did not)
turf: End-times corners, proto-Reckoners
look: Prophet fashion, misspelled banners, real bombs
origin: A 2020 apocalypse cult-gang. The 2020 sourcebook spelling is part of the stain. Reckoners later professionalised the void with merch. The Comming (sic) professionalised nothing except the blast radius.
text: Historical doomsday crew. A 2045 Reckoner will call them amateurs. The craters remain.
hooks: A misspelled banner showed up in the Glen. Reckoners want it gone before it dilutes the brand.
A 2020 timer in a chapel is still counting. The chapel is now a Night Market.
A prophet's grandchild wants the file closed. An Inquisitor wants it taught.

name: Sinners N' Saints
turf: Church-and-club double life
look: Half choir, half knife, matching ink
leader: A pair of twins, if the stories are true
origin: A 2020 gang that split every night between nave and neon. Valentinos later made faith and family a real government. The Sinners N' Saints made it a costume with a body count.
text: Historical church boosters. Padre will not claim them. A Glen priest might still have their candle list.
hooks: A saint's candle in a Heywood church has a chip in the wax. The chip is a 2020 hit list.
A club using the old name is shaking down a choir. The Valentinos have opinions.
Twins in 2045 are copying the bit. One of them is a netrunner. One of them is a problem.

name: Warrior Heart
turf: Dojo-and-feelings circuit
look: Martial arts, heart motifs, a manifesto about honor that did not stop the bullets
origin: A 2020 guardian/poser gang that tried to make honor a street brand. Willows later did the therapy without the logo. Sacred Blades did the dojo without the heart. Warrior Heart did both and lost to guns.
text: A historical honorable-mention. Ingénue will not like the comparison. A 2020 table can still train in their room.
hooks: A Warrior Heart coin looks like a Willows coin on a bad night. A veteran almost shot a friend.
A dojo lease is in the old name. Claws want the building. The lease has a clause that needs a lawyer or a solo.
